title: @ycforge/pilot build-env — resolved build environment runtime API contract
description: Machine-readable contract for the Project C build-env runtime-prep layer (spec 012). Documents the input (BuildConfig + snapshot env), the output (resolved buildEnv + interpolated buildConfig), the EnvValue kind grammar, and the PML_ENV_UNRESOLVED runtime diagnostics shape. Additive: adds the PML_ENV_UNRESOLVED code to the shared project-model catalog (contracts/011/project-model.json) — no .ycsf format version change.

envValue.title: Interretetation of one build_env record entry

oneOf.title: null kind — strict requirement from process env
interpolated kind — contains one or more {{$NAME}}

buildEnvResolutionResult.title: Per-app result of build_env resolution + build_config interpolation

oneOf.title: success — resolved env + interpolated opaque build_config

resolvedEnv.description: Effective env map; no null, no residual {{$...}} (FR-006).

file.description: App build_config source path, e.g. analytics/build_config.yaml.

preparedBuildEnv.title: Public per-app materialized input for spec 021 → BuildContext (spec 002)

errorCodes.title: PML_ENV_UNRESOLVED — additive runtime code
errorCodes.description: Runtime fail-fast code added to the shared project-model catalog (contracts/011/project-model.json). Distinct from load-time PML_ENV_NOT_SET so 020/021 can tell load vs runtime-prep failures apart. Additive / semver-compatible (Constitution III).

PML_ENV_UNRESOLVED.description: A {{$NAME}} in build_config/build_env could not be resolved to a non-empty process-env value, or a residual {{$NAME}} remains, at runtime-prep (spec 012).
